description: This file contains a utility program written in C to calculate the 6rd subnet based on IPv6 prefix and IPv4 address inputs. It provides command-line parsing, address parsing, and subnet calculation logic.

methods.name: void print_usage()
methods.description: Prints usage instructions for the command-line utility and exits.

methods.name: void print_error()
methods.description: Outputs the current error message based on errno and exits.

methods.name: void parse_str(int af,char * str,void * addr,unsigned long * mask)
methods.description: Parses an IP address and its mask from a string, converting them into network address structures and masks; handles IPv4 and IPv6 based on the address family.
parameters: int af: address family (AF_INET or AF_INET6)
char *str: string containing the address with mask
void *addr: pointer to store the parsed address
unsigned long *mask: pointer to store the parsed mask value

methods.name: int main(int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Main function that processes input arguments, parses addresses, calculates the combined IPv6 subnet, and outputs the resulting subnet prefix.

ctags.name: parse_str
ctags.pattern: /^static void parse_str(int af, char *str, void *addr, unsigned long *mask)$/
